name: Ibuki
source:
"A... riddle..? Ah, haha. Right, sure. I've been mulling over the answer forever."

An enigmatic young man who gives Yuuki some cryptic information. His gentle demeanor and calm attitude belie his age.

He's waiting for an answer only Yuuki can give him.

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/paradox/characters/]official website[/url]]
